[CR CR0005 for 38.104] TS 38.104 Combined updates (NSA) from RAN4 #86bis and RAN4 #87 4.1Relationship with other core specifications The present document is a single-RAT specification for a BS, covering RF characteristics and minimum performance requirements. Conducted and radiated core requirements are defined for the BS architectures and BS types defined in subclause 4.3. The applicability of each requirement is described in clause 5. [DEL]Editor’s note: The first version of NR specifications will only be single-RAT. In the next step, that will have updates to the MSR BS or AAS BS specifications for including NR, there will be a need for more explanatory text in this subclause.[/DEL]

[8] (ran4_cr_chunks 38.133, sim=0.5458)
[CR CR4241r2 for 38.133] CR to 38.133 CatF R17 on PC1,5,6 RRM Parameters for RAN5 <Start of Change #1> [CR CR4241r2 for 38.133] CR to 38.133 CatF R17 on PC1,5,6 RRM Parameters for RAN5 A.3.15.3Setup 3: 2 AoAs There are 2 active probes in the test. The DL signals, and noise if applicable, transmitted from the two active probes, align to directions (AoAs) which are from the set of directions corresponding to the EIS spherical coverage percentile of the DUT as defined in clause 7.3.4 of TS 38.101-2 [19] for each UE power class. The relative angular offset between the directions (AoAs) of the 2 active probes, shall be changed for each test iteration. The applicable set of relative angular offsets between the 2 active probes is given in Table 3.15.3-1 for each UE power class. Editor Note: If RA
